To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the sensitivity to the four-fermi contact interaction is enhanced by the availability of both electron and polarized positron beams; (b) the reach in the contact interaction parameter space can be further increased by using optimal kinematical and polarization cuts.

the sensitivity to contact interactions at a future Linear Collider with polarized beams is signicantly higher than the one that would be obtained with the same collider but with unpolarized beams, and that the sensitivity is further improved when both beams are longitudinally polarized.

the sensitivity to the contact interactions can be improved by a factor 2-4, depending on the process and the coupling considered, by the use of positron polarization, and by the optimization of cuts on the polarized integrated cross section.
